- About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises.

With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures.

- About this position:

You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information.

Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols, improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures.

We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks, working closely with our research and engineering teams.

With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap.

- What you'll do:

Spin-based quantum experiments

  • Design, develop and optimize optical experiments involving spin-photon sources.
  • Implement optical control schemes for spin initialization, readout and manipulation.
  • Characterize spin coherence, operation fidelity and entanglement quality.

Scientific and experimental ownership

  • Independently drive experimental investigations, from design to validation.
  • Structure and prioritize scientific activities, milestones and technical challenges.
  • Troubleshoot complex experimental systems and propose technical improvements.
  • Share expertise and support less experienced colleagues when relevant.

Technology development and integration

  • Develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols.
  • Collaborate with theory, electronics and semiconductor technology teams.
  • Improve experimental robustness, reproducibility and system performance.
  • Translate scientific results into demonstrators and technological building blocks for future multi-spin architectures.

- How You Will Grow:

During your first 3 months 
You will become familiar with Quandela's experimental platforms and ongoing demonstrators, contributing your expertise to current technical challenges.

Within 6 months 
You will drive dedicated experimental workstreams, contribute to key technical decisions and strengthen theory-to-experiment feedback loops.

Within 1 year 
You will help shape the team's experimental direction, advance distributed entanglement demonstrations and contribute to future spin-based architectures.

Requirements

- What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced experimental researcher combining strong scientific expertise, technical autonomy and the ability to drive complex research activities.

Must-have

  • PhD in Spin Physics, Quantum Optics or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with spin-based quantum systems (control, readout or coherence measurements).
  • Proven autonomy in designing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex quantum experiments.
  • Strong understanding of quantum optics, spin coherence and experimental measurement techniques.
  • Ability to lead scientific activities and make independent technical decisions.
  • Comfortable collaborating across experimental, theory and engineering teams

Important, but you can grow here

  • Photon-mediated entanglement protocols and multi-spin architectures.
  • Semiconductor quantum emitters, quantum dots and spin-photon interfaces.
  • Advanced optical control, cryogenic platforms and fast electronics.
  • Experimental qualification, system integration and technology transfer.

Bonus points

  • Experience bridging academic research and industrial R&D.
  • Experience coordinating scientific projects or mentoring researchers.

- Career Stage & Team Contribution: 

We primarily target candidates with a PhD and 4+ years of postdoctoral or equivalent R&D experience, combining scientific expertise with strong experimental autonomy.

Researchers completing a substantial postdoc are also welcome if they demonstrate scientific maturity, technical ownership and readiness for broader responsibilities.

People management experience is not required. What matters is your ability to drive scientific activities, tackle complex technical challenges and share your expertise with the team.

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing and a company savings plan. 
  • Public transport subscription covered at 50%. 
  • Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car). 
  • Fully covered health insurance (Alan). 
  • Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate). 
  • Access to a nursery via choisir-ma-creche or contribution to childcare expenses. 
  • Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib). 
  • Meal subsidies (Swile). 

 Localisation of the position : Based at the IPVF campus in Palaiseau, within the Paris-Saclay research ecosystem. 

Process: 

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30–45 min)
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 min)
  • Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work
  • Meeting with the team and scientific discussion
  • Reference checks
  • Offer

- Beyond That

At Quandela, you'll work on challenging scientific questions while helping turn experimental advances into technologies for future quantum computers.

Our spin-based platforms are still evolving, leaving room to explore new approaches, influence technical directions and take real ownership of experimental challenges.

If you're excited by the idea of combining ambitious quantum research with tangible technological impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your background doesn't match every requirement.

title: Global Government Affairs Director
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

GLOBAL GOVERNMENT AFFAIRS DIRECTOR

We are seeking Global Government Affairs Director to support SpaceXSI’s business and growth objectives primarily in London/UK through direct global lobbying efforts and strategic coalition building on a range of issues.

You will own SpaceXSI’s market development and stakeholder engagement strategy for the region. You will lead efforts to position SpaceXSI as the trusted partner for frontier AI deployments across the European governments. This role combines strategic market leadership, high-level stakeholder engagement, revenue acceleration, and cross-functional influence. You will operate as an individual contributor while collaborating closely with global and local leadership to ensure government priorities align with and inform SpaceXSI’s broader international growth.  

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the identification, qualification, and development of European governments and strategic enterprise opportunities, building and managing a robust pipeline for Enterprise Sales teams to convert into revenue-generating agreements
  • Conduct rigorous market research and competitive analysis to assess demand for SpaceXSI's technologies, map the European AI and public sector landscape, identify barriers to entry, and develop strategies that accelerate SpaceXSI’s growth in Europe
  • Elevate SpaceXSI’s brand and presence in Europe as a mission-driven, trusted leader in frontier AI, positioning the company as the partner of choice for transformative public sector and critical national infrastructure initiatives
  • Build and expand a senior-level network of advocates and partners across Europe national governments, local government, academia, industry bodies, and the private sector to champion SpaceXSI’s growth and open strategic doors
  • Drive significant increases in win rates on complex European government and strategic enterprise deals by providing strategic counsel, executive sponsorship, and high-touch enablement to pursuit and sales teams
  • Shape favorable funding, procurement, policy, and regulatory conditions that enable SpaceXSI’s successful market entry, expansion, and long-term positioning in Europe
  • Provide executive-level air cover and personal leadership on the highest-priority European pursuits, including leading government briefings, negotiations, and strategic relationship management

title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
description: Life at Plume At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. Plume is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Customer Solutions Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key technical advisor, you'll work directly with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), acting as the bridge between their business needs and our cutting-edge solutions. You'll play a crucial role in the sales process, from initial discovery to successful deployment, ensuring our partners achieve maximum value from our products. This is a fantastic opportunity for a technically adept individual with a passion for networking, cloud, and AI who thrives in a customer-facing role. Responsibilities Technical Trusted Advisor: Engage with ISPs to deeply understand their technical and business requirements, and then effectively demonstrate how Plume's solutions can meet and exceed those needs. Product Demos & Trials: Conduct compelling product demonstrations and manage complex proof-of-concept (PoC) and field trials, showcasing the tangible benefits of Plume's technology. System Integration: Collaborate with our internal Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Operational teams to understand and deliver Plume's solutions within a customer's ecosystem. Sales Enablement: Work closely with the sales organization to drive revenue, achieve sales quotas, and contribute to the overall growth of the business. Presentations & Events: Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and represent Plume at industry events and conferences. Product Development Input: Provide valuable feedback to our product and engineering teams based on customer requirements and market trends, helping to inform the development of new features and solutions. Technical Support: Offer prompt local and remote technical support for PoCs, lab trials, and deployment ramp-ups, ensuring a smooth and successful customer journey. Industry Expertise: Continuously research and stay up-to-date on the latest industry standards and emerging technologies in networking, cloud architectures, and AI. Experience & Qualifications Hands-on Technical Experience: Strong hands-on experience in the configuration and deployment of software and hardware, including Wi-Fi, networking equipment, and cloud services. A fundamental understanding of cloud architectures and AI principles is essential. Deep understanding and knowledge of Residential and SMB Gateways is a big plus. ISP SaaS Experience: Proven experience working with ISPs to deploy large-scale SaaS network solutions to millions of endpoints. Communication & Collaboration: A track record of developing and maintaining professional, cooperative relationships with all levels of staff and customers. Networking & Cloud Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CWNA, CCNA, or AWS Solutions Architect are highly preferred. Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in a fast-paced environment. Qualification Requirements Experience: 5+ years of related experience working with network, security, SaaS, and/or AI industries. Education: A BS/BA degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience. Industry Knowledge: In-depth industry knowledge and a strong understanding of SDN and wireless technologies, solutions, and product offerings are preferred. Communication Skills: Advanced written and oral communication skills. Travel: Ability to travel >70% of the time. Location/Language: This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in United Kingdom or Netherlands and be fluent in English. About Plume As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer , you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing. What you'll be doing Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines. Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs. Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints. Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations. Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust. Your Profile MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus). Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship. Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal). Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis. Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation. Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team. WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Are you always one step ahead? The kind of person who has the new hire’s laptop ready before they arrive, notices the meeting-room camera is offline before the call starts, and, after fixing the same problem twice, makes sure nobody has to ask a third time?

We’re looking for an IT Helpdesk Specialist for our Amsterdam office. You’ll own on-site IT here and support colleagues in other hubs remotely, as part of a small global IT team across Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan. Our own AI helpdesk agent already answers routine questions in Slack, so your time goes to the work that needs a person: hands-on help, judgment on unclear or risky requests, and care for the people you support.

Our team is organized by domains, and you’ll grow into one of them: Access & Identity (Okta), the area behind most of our requests. Real ownership, from day one. Ready to make it yours?

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the IT team:

We're a small global team in Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan, and we keep 400+ manychatters working smoothly and securely. We're organized by domains, so everyone owns an area end to end. AI is part of how we work, including our own helpdesk agent. Our docs live in GitHub, so one good answer helps many people.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

On-site and remote support

  • Be the first person colleagues in Amsterdam reach for IT help: at your desk, in Slack, and through our service desk (Freshservice). Support colleagues in other hubs remotely.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity on a Mac-first fleet managed with Jamf, with some Windows devices. Escalate complex issues to IT Administrators with full context, logs, and what you've already tried.

  • Get every new hire ready on day one (laptop, peripherals, accounts, and a walkthrough of our tools), and close access and collect equipment for leavers, working with the People and Talent teams.

Office, meeting rooms, and events

  • Keep office IT running: Wi-Fi and wired network (UniFi), printers, office access control, Zoom Rooms, displays, and room schedulers. Make sure meeting rooms are ready every day, and work with the building operator, ISPs, and vendors until every issue is resolved.

  • Set up and run AV for All-Hands, internal events, and meetups: microphones, cameras, displays, and streaming when needed. Some events happen outside regular hours.

  • Keep the office hardware inventory accurate in Freshservice Assets, manage the loaner pool and spares, and support local purchases, refreshes, and decommissioning.

Access & Identity (Okta)

  • Run day-to-day Okta administration: users, groups and group rules, app assignments, password resets, MFA, and lifecycle states.

Knowledge and automation

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • 3+ years of IT support in a SaaS or cloud-first company, where you've covered a broad scope and know the full helpdesk lifecycle.

  • Strong macOS skills and hands-on Jamf (or similar MDM) experience; working knowledge of Windows.

  • Hands-on Okta administration (or a comparable identity provider such as Entra ID): groups and group rules, app assignments, SAML or OIDC app integration, SCIM provisioning, and user lifecycle.

  • Onboarding and offboarding experience: you know what "day-1 ready" means and deliver it every time.

  • AI as part of how you work. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini every day, and describe the task clearly, check the output before you trust it. This one's a must.

  • Clear writing and fluent English: short, useful answers for users, and articles a colleague can follow without asking you.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

title: AI Builder
description: The short version Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in. As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching. We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building. What Contentoo does Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap. None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster. There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages. title: GPU Engineer
description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results. We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually. This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it. Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai . What you'll work on You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work. Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions. Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks. Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements. Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs. Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs. raw.title: GPU Engineer
raw.description:
About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

  • Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

  • KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

  • Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

  • Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

  • Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

  • Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

  • Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

  • Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

  • Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

  • Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

  • Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

  • Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

title: Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)
description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu. Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it's difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate. We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn't make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission. Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours. Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of their teams. You will work closely with product managers, and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.   • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4-6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Valued skills and experience

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. Prioritise team resources across regions, verticals and commercial opportunities. Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, collaboration and knowledge sharing. title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks. What you will do: Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows. Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction. Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners. Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting). Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively. title: CFD Workflow Automation Intern
description: About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse. About the role: We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department. The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important. Key Responsibilities: • Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities. • Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments. • Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent. • Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes. • Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers. • Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings. • Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements. What you need to be successful: • Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field. • Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage. • Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation. • Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution. • Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory. • Fluency in written and spoken English. Soft Skills: • Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving. • Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package. • Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams. • Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability. • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment. Other useful skills: • Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization. • Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers. • Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation. • Familiarity with Git or another version-control system. • Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required. • Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage. Supervision and collaboration: The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams. Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace. More about us… We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values: Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals. Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement. Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals. If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

What you need to be successful:

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Soft Skills:

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

Other useful skills:

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

Supervision and collaboration:

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.

title: Customer Operations Manager Kontoeröffnung (m/w/d)
description: Eine Hausverwaltung sagt Ja zu Getmomo. Ab da bist du dran: Du sorgst dafür, dass aus der Zusage ein laufendes Konto wird. Du sammelst die nötigen Unterlagen, bereitest sie für unsere Partnerbanken auf, hältst den Kontakt zu allen Beteiligten und bleibst dran, bis alles startklar ist. Und weil du diesen Weg jeden Tag gehst, siehst du zuerst, wo er schneller werden kann. Auf einen Blick Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit, 40 Stunden pro Woche 42.000 bis 48.000 € brutto im Jahr Hybrid: 4 Tage pro Woche im Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg Start: ab sofort Das machst du bei uns Kontoeröffnungen bis zum Ende bringen: Du übernimmst Hausverwaltungen nach der Zusage und begleitest jede Kontoeröffnung, bis alles startklar ist. Unterlagen zusammenstellen: Du sammelst die Unterlagen, die unsere Partnerbanken für eine Kontoeröffnung brauchen, prüfst sie auf Vollständigkeit und leitest sie an die Bank weiter. Fehlt etwas, holst du es beim Kunden ein. Eng mit unseren Partnerbanken zusammenarbeiten: Du bist die tägliche Ansprechperson für unsere Partnerbanken, reichst Fälle ein, klärst Rückfragen gemeinsam und behältst im Blick, dass jeder Fall zügig weiterläuft. Hausverwaltungen durch den Prozess führen: Du erklärst, was als Nächstes kommt, bleibst freundlich und hartnäckig dran, auch wenn bei der Verwaltung gerade anderes brennt, und achtest darauf, dass alle den vereinbarten Weg gehen. Anliegen im Bestand: Auch wenn sich bei bestehenden Kunden etwas ändert, das die Bank betrifft, etwa neue Verfügungsberechtigte, läuft das über dich. Den Prozess besser machen: Jede Rückfrage ist ein Hinweis, was wir beim nächsten Mal vorher klären können. Du baust daraus mit dem Team Prüfregeln, Vorlagen und Automatisierungen, mit Salesforce, einem eigenen AI-nativen ERP, Slack und KI-Assistenten, die bei uns zum Alltag gehören. Woran du deinen Erfolg merkst Aus Zusagen werden schneller startklare Kunden. Rückfragen werden seltener, weil Unterlagen beim ersten Mal vollständig sind. Kein Fall geht unter, weder bei uns, noch beim Kunden, noch bei der Bank. Das bringst du mit Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung, zum Beispiel in BWL, Wirtschaftsrecht, bei einer Bank oder in der Immobilienwirtschaft. Quereinstieg ist ausdrücklich willkommen. Erste Berufserfahrung mit Kunden, egal ob aus Bank, Hausverwaltung, Kundenservice, Vertrieb oder Operations. Bankprodukte und die Abläufe einer Kontoeröffnung bringen wir dir bei. Du bleibst dran: Auch beim dritten Nachfassen bist du freundlich, klar und verbindlich. Du arbeitest genau. Ein fehlendes Dokument fällt dir auf, bevor es jemand anderes merkt. Du behältst bei vielen offenen Fällen gleichzeitig den Überblick und weißt bei jedem, wer gerade am Zug ist. Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools und schaffst wiederkehrende Handarbeit mit KI und Automatisierung ab. Perfektes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch. Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wie du arbeitest, ist uns wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf. Das bekommst du bei uns Einen echten Einblick, wie Banking von innen funktioniert: Kontoeröffnung, Zahlungsverkehr, Zusammenarbeit mit Banken. Eigene Fälle und eigene Verbesserungsprojekte ab dem ersten Monat. Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung durch das Kontoeröffnungsteam, Mentoring und regelmäßiges Feedback. Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Büro an der Oranienstraße in Kreuzberg, hybrides Arbeiten, Firmenlaptop, kostenlose Getränke und Team-Events. Das klingt nach dir? title: Vestigingsmanager Onderwijs
description: Wil jij de verantwoordelijkheid over jouw eigen vestiging, leidinggeven aan een team én dagelijks impact maken op de ontwikkeling van jongeren? Bij Lyceo combineer je ondernemerschap, management en onderwijs in één rol. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, volop vrijheid en de kans om zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de groei van leerlingen én jouw vestiging. Taken Maak het verschil als Vestigingsmanager Als Vestigingsmanager ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw Lyceo-vestiging. Dankzij jouw inzet krijgen leerlingen de begeleiding die hen helpt effectiever te leren, meer zelfvertrouwen te ontwikkelen en betere resultaten te behalen. Je runt jouw eigen vestiging als een ondernemer binnen de organisatie. Daarbij stuur je een team van studentbegeleiders aan, onderhoud je contact met ouders en scholen en zorg je ervoor dat de vestiging kwalitatief én organisatorisch optimaal presteert. Je bent dagelijks zichtbaar aanwezig, signaleert kansen in de regio en bouwt aan duurzame samenwerkingen met scholen en ouders. Daarnaast ben je actief onderdeel van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en ondersteun je leerlingen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding. Juist die combinatie van management en persoonlijke begeleiding maakt deze rol zo afwisselend en betekenisvol. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het: leidinggeven aan, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team studentbegeleiders; voeren van intake-, evaluatie- en adviesgesprekken met leerlingen en ouders; organiseren van roosters, administratie en plannen van aanpak; opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met scholen en andere stakeholders in de regio; actief onderdeel zijn van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en leerlingen ondersteunen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding; realiseren van groei, kwaliteit en resultaat binnen jouw vestiging. Vereisten Voor deze vacature neem jij mee: Jij krijgt energie van het combineren van onderwijs, management en ondernemerschap. Je bent zelfstandig, besluitvaardig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw vestiging. Daarnaast weet je overzicht te bewaren, kansen te signaleren en relaties op te bouwen met leerlingen, ouders, scholen en collega's. Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en resultaat hand in hand gaan. Ervaring in een leidinggevende, coördinerende of ondernemende rol helpt je om snel succesvol te zijn in deze functie. Vink jij deze checklist ook af? • hbo werk- en denkniveau; • affiniteit met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van jongeren; • ondernemende instelling en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel; • commercieel inzicht en oog voor groei en resultaat; • sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden; • we zoeken kandidaten op goede reisafstand van jouw vestiging. We hebben momenteel kansen in de volgende plaatsen: Hengelo, Utrecht, Laren en Delft. Jouw werkgebied Lyceo heeft ruim 100 vestigingen en daarmee altijd een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Wij zoeken vestigingsmanagers voor de regio’s: Bussum, Laren en Delft. Je bent dagelijks aanwezig binnen de vestiging en werkt nauw samen met leerlingen, ouders, begeleiders en onderwijsprofessionals. Daarnaast onderhoud je contact met scholen en andere betrokkenen in de regio en bouw je actief aan de groei en kwaliteit van de vestiging. Benefits Als gedreven vestigingsmanager kun jij rekenen op: Een zelfstandige managementfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen een maatschappelijk betrokken en resultaatgerichte organisatie. Lyceo geeft je de ruimte om jouw eigen vestiging te runnen, ondersteunt je met professionele begeleiding en investeert actief in jouw ontwikkeling en groei. Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop: • volledig door Lyceo betaalde pensioenbijdrage van 6%; • variabele beloningsmogelijkheden gekoppeld aan resultaten en groei; • een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week, net wat past bij jouw situatie, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband; • vrij tijdens de schoolvakanties*; • laptop en telefoon van de zaak; • volledige ov-vergoeding of reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer; • toegang tot de Lyceo Academie met diverse trainingen en opleidingen; • persoonlijke begeleiding door een clustermanager en een eigen buddy; • aantrekkelijke kortingen via Benefits At Work; • regelmatige borrels, teamuitjes en een jaarlijks feest; • betekenisvol werk, waarbij resultaat en impact hand in hand gaan. *Naast de meivakantie en de laatste week van de zomervakantie ben je tijdens alle schoolvakanties vrij. Hiervoor wordt maandelijks 5,77% ingehouden ter compensatie van deze bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen, naast de 25 wettelijke vakantiedagen. Je bouwt vakantiegeld en pensioen op over je volledige bruto maandsalaris. Werken bij Lyceo Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen via programma’s zoals huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen. Als marktleider binnen dit domein is Lyceo volop in beweging. De organisatie groeit hard en heeft duidelijke ambities voor de toekomst. Je komt terecht in een betrokken en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat, maar waar ook ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. De impact is groot: scholen beoordelen Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger. We zoeken continu naar de beste samenwerking tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs en doen er alles aan om ieder kind tot z’n recht te laten komen. • hbo werk- en denkniveau;

• affiniteit met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van jongeren;

• ondernemende instelling en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel;

• commercieel inzicht en oog voor groei en resultaat;

• sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden;

• we zoeken kandidaten op goede reisafstand van jouw vestiging. We hebben momenteel kansen in de volgende plaatsen: Hengelo, Utrecht, Laren en Delft.

Jouw werkgebied

Lyceo heeft ruim 100 vestigingen en daarmee altijd een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Wij zoeken vestigingsmanagers voor de regio’s: Bussum, Laren en Delft.

Je bent dagelijks aanwezig binnen de vestiging en werkt nauw samen met leerlingen, ouders, begeleiders en onderwijsprofessionals. Daarnaast onderhoud je contact met scholen en andere betrokkenen in de regio en bouw je actief aan de groei en kwaliteit van de vestiging.

Benefits

Als gedreven vestigingsmanager kun jij rekenen op:

Een zelfstandige managementfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen een maatschappelijk betrokken en resultaatgerichte organisatie. Lyceo geeft je de ruimte om jouw eigen vestiging te runnen, ondersteunt je met professionele begeleiding en investeert actief in jouw ontwikkeling en groei.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

• volledig door Lyceo betaalde pensioenbijdrage van 6%;

• variabele beloningsmogelijkheden gekoppeld aan resultaten en groei;

• een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week, net wat past bij jouw situatie, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;

• vrij tijdens de schoolvakanties*;

• laptop en telefoon van de zaak;

• volledige ov-vergoeding of reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer;

• toegang tot de Lyceo Academie met diverse trainingen en opleidingen;

• persoonlijke begeleiding door een clustermanager en een eigen buddy;

• aantrekkelijke kortingen via Benefits At Work;

• regelmatige borrels, teamuitjes en een jaarlijks feest;

• betekenisvol werk, waarbij resultaat en impact hand in hand gaan.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen via programma’s zoals huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen.

title: Manager Service Operations & AI
description: Ben jij een ervaren IT Operations Manager die niet alleen een supportorganisatie kan aansturen, maar ook kansen ziet om dienstverlening slimmer en efficiënter te maken met AI? Dan hebben wij een interessante uitdaging voor je. Voor Fivespark, een ambitieuze Managed Service Provider in Amstelveen, zoeken wij een Manager Service Operations & AI. In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je operationeel leiderschap met procesverbetering, automatisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van een eigen AI-agent. Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening. Over Fivespark Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen. De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen. Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren. De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid. Wat ga je doen? Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen. Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers. Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening. Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties. Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten. Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert. Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega. Processen verbeteren en automatiseren Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering. Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies. Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI. Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren. Verandering begeleiden Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners. Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken. Je creëert draagvlak, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie. Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening. Daarnaast beschik je over: Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management. Ervaring met het aansturing, coachen en ontwikkelen van operationele teams. Goede kennis van ITIL-processen en servicemanagement. Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en digitale innovatie. Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden. Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met verandermanagement. Je hoeft geen AI-developer te zijn. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen. Wat kun je verwachten? Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever en krijgt een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in de toekomst van IT-dienstverlening. Je kunt rekenen op: Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.487 tot €6.494, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Een mobiliteitsbudget van €850 per maand, vrij in te zetten op de manier die bij jou past. Een fulltime dienstverband. Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en ruimte om hybride te werken. Veel zelfstandigheid en directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. De kans om actief bij te dragen aan innovatieve AI- en automatiseringsprojecten. Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen. Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie. Waarom is dit een interessante functie? Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie. Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om processen structureel te verbeteren, nieuwe technologie toe te passen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop IT-dienstverlening wordt georganiseerd. Een mooie uitdaging voor een ervaren Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager of Support Manager die toe is aan een volgende stap. Interesse? We are currently looking for a Product Owner – Digital Assets to join our Product Management team and define, structure and drive the development of Digital Assets capabilities within our existing multi-asset trading platform. This newly created role combines product strategy and execution: the first objective is to structure and define the Digital Assets scope, build the roadmap and position the offer through market and competitive analysis, before leading its implementation and acting as the internal reference point on Digital Assets topics.

If you join us, you will: 

Product Strategy & Build (Primary Focus) 

  • Define the Digital Assets product vision and positioning
  • Build and maintain the Digital Assets roadmap 
  • Conduct market and competitive analysis 
  • Identify relevant use cases aligned with our existing client base 
  • Define how Digital Assets capabilities integrate within our current architecture
  • Assess regulatory and compliance implications related to Digital Assets initiatives 

Product Delivery 

  • Translate product vision into clear functional specifications
  • Own and prioritize the backlog
  • Work closely with Engineering teams to drive implementation 
  • Ensure alignment between roadmap objectives and delivery 

Internal Enablement 

  • Act as internal reference on Digital Assets topics
  • Support Sales and Client Delivery teams in understanding new capabilities

Profile 

  • Minimum 4 years of experience in Financial Markets, Electronic Trading or Digital Assets
  • Exposure to crypto markets, tokenization or digital asset-related projects
  • Exposure to derivative products
  • Experience in Product Ownership, Product Management or Business Analysis 
  • Strong understanding of trading workflows and real-time systems 
  • Ability to structure a product line and define roadmap priorities 
  • Awareness of regulatory constraints related to Digital Assets environments 
  • Comfortable working in Agile environments 

Technical Environment 

  • Multi-process core application (Java-based architecture)
  • Real-time and low latency systems
  • API-driven integrations (REST, FIX, messaging systems) 
  • Cross-asset architecture supporting equities, derivatives and evolving Digital Assets features
  • Close interaction between Product, Engineering and infrastructure teams 

Why Join Us 

  •  Contribute to the development of a new strategic product lin

  • International exposure

title: Principal Fire Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they’re passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Job Overview

Jensen Hughes are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Principal Fire Engineer to join our growing team in London. This is a technical leadership role offering the opportunity to deliver complex fire engineering projects across a diverse portfolio of sectors including commercial, residential, healthcare, education, industrial, and infrastructure developments.

As a Principal Fire Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping fire safety strategies, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting business growth through strong client relationships and technical innovation. You will not only lead on some of the industry’s most exciting projects but also have a key role in shaping the future talent within our teams through mentorship and development opportunities.

Why join us to grow your career?

  • We are the largest fire consultancy in Europe with offices located in Belgium, Finland, Denmark, Italy, and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for providing innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.
  • As a Principal Engineer you will be an integral part of a dynamic technical team, working with other experienced Engineers, Surveyors and teams including our Forensics division. You will work on the industry's leading technical projects.
  • Working with us offers an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team that always strives to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.
  • You will be given early the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to achieve chartered status and offer help and support during the process

Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver complex fire engineering projects from inception through to completion.
  • Develop fire strategies for a wide range of new-build and existing building projects.
  • Undertake fire safety engineering analyses, including evacuation modelling, smoke control assessments, and performance-based design solutions.
  • Provide expert advice on compliance with UK Building Regulations, Approved Document B, and relevant fire safety legislation.
  • Review and approve technical reports, calculations, and design documentation.
  • Liaise with architects, developers, contractors, approval authorities, and wider project teams.
  • Act as a technical lead and mentor for junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Contribute to business development activities, including client engagement, tender submissions, and project proposals.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving legislation, industry standards, and best practices.
  • Represent the business at client meetings, industry events, and technical forums.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Degree qualified in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • Ideally be or working towards becoming a Chartered Engineer.
  • A background in fire engineering preferably within a consultancy environment.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus scheme.
  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.
  • Private healthcare.
  • Generous pension contribution.
  • Life assurance and income protection.
  • Professional membership subscriptions.
  • Ongoing training and support towards professional development.
  • Clear career progression pathways.
  • A collaborative and inclusive working environment where technical excellence is valued and rewarded.

#LI-SG1 #LI-hybrid

 

Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

 

At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.  We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.  Please click here to review.
