title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Strategic Accounts
description: Company Overview Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models. AI-First by Default At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does. Opportunity: Enterprise restaurant deployments are where voice AI meets the messiness of the real world: legacy systems, high transaction volumes, operational edge cases, and technology that has to work reliably during the busiest moments of the day. In this role, you will embed with leading restaurant brands and technology partners to make those deployments successful. You will learn how their systems work, design the integration path, write code, troubleshoot production issues, and adapt Deepgram’s platform to the constraints of live restaurant operations. You will work directly with customer engineering teams and business leaders, owning the technical path from early discovery through go-live and optimization. Your impact will extend beyond any single customer. You will identify patterns across deployments, translate field learnings into product improvements, and build the tools, reference architectures, and playbooks that help the team deploy faster and more reliably across large restaurant fleets. This role is for an engineer who wants direct ownership of customer outcomes and enjoys turning complex, ambiguous deployments into repeatable systems. The goal is simple: make every Deepgram for Restaurants deployment feel effortless to the customer and deliver measurable value from day one. Location: This role is based in New York City or San Francisco, where many of our customers and partners are located. Being close to them helps us move quickly and stay connected to their needs. This role also includes occasional travel to meet with customers, support sales engagements, and participate in key onsite interactions. What You’ll Own: Customer engineering partnership: Embed with customer engineering teams as a trusted technical peer. Lead technical discovery and solutioning for prospects and customers. Technical integration and deployment: Own the end-to-end technical implementation of Deepgram’s voice AI platform for enterprise customers — from scoping and architecture through go-live and optimization. Configuration and customization: Adapt and configure Deepgram’s platform to meet each customer’s unique operational requirements — menu structures, ordering flows, POS integrations, edge cases, and everything in between. Production excellence: Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues in live deployments. Serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues when necessary. Deployment infrastructure leadership: Codify patterns into tools, playbooks, reference architectures, and building blocks the broader team can use for other deployments and customers. Feedback loop to product and engineering: Translate real-world deployment challenges into actionable requirements for Deepgram’s product and engineering teams. You are the voice of the customer inside the building. You’ll Love This Role If You: You are hands-on. You write code, read logs, and ship fixes — you don’t just coordinate. When a customer has a technical problem, you roll up your sleeves and solve it. You operate with extreme ownership and urgency. You treat every customer deployment as if your name is on the product. You partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering, but you are just as comfortable on a customer’s Slack channel walking their team through an API integration. It’s Important To Us That You Have: Technical depth: You are an excellent software engineer. You are comfortable working across APIs, SDKs, webhooks, cloud infrastructure, and customer tech stacks. You use AI coding tools to move fast and multiply your output. Customer obsession: Deep, personal commitment to your customers’ technical success. You take their problems home with you. You are not satisfied until the deployment is bulletproof. High slope: Learns fast, adapts quickly, and stays effective in ambiguity without needing constant structure. You figure things out and move forward. You are excited to get your hands dirty solving gritty technical problems over sexy ones. Communication and trust: Able to build deep credibility with both technical and non-technical stakeholders on the customer side. You are calm under pressure and relentlessly reliable. It Would Be Great if You Had: Experience with voice AI, speech-to-text, NLP, or conversational AI systems. Previous early-stage startup or founder-led environment experience — you thrive in environments where you wear many hats and build from zero. Previous experience embedded within a large enterprise customer’s product deployment. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

Staff Web Engineer Marketing

About the role

Deepgram builds foundational voice AI and deepgram.com is where the world meets it. The site is our digital front door, showcasing our products, brand moments, and pricing information, and it drives the company's self-serve revenue.

We're hiring a Staff Web Engineer to own the site's code for the long haul. Deepgram.com is entering its next chapter. We are fully refreshing the experience top to bottom. You'll be the person who knows the site inside out. You'll own the repo, the architecture, the Sanity environments, and the QA bar — and act as the code-review gate for day-to-day page and content work. The team is small but scaling. You will be working on the Web team reporting into the Head of Brand & Awareness and closely collaborating with our Senior Web Manager, product, marketing, sales, and external development partners.

Most critically, as an AI company, you must be AI-native. Agents and AI tooling are your go-to in how you choose to build, review, and QA. We are aiming to build a machine-first, voice-first site experience. It’s an exciting time to join the web team.

What you'll do

  • Own the deepgram.com codebase end to end — the Next.js application (front and back end), the GitHub repo, branching and CI/CD, and code review

  • Optimize and maintain Sanity CMS architecture — schemas, the reusable module library, the staging and production environments and publishing workflow

  • Run the global design system, component library, Vercel platform and spearhead AI integrations. Experienced with global CSS systems.

  • Build and run the site's QA program — starting with a well-structured and scalable staging environment that keeps a marketing site launch-ready at all times

  • Lead internationalization and localization efforts — language-locale URL and routing architecture, hreflang, and the path from i18n plumbing to localized (l10n) content

  • Assist in technical SEO — site architecture, redirects, Core Web Vitals — with on-page SEO executed by content partners inside your review gate

  • Ensure LLM discoverability (AEO) — the site's structured data, metadata, and content architecture must serve answer engines as well as people

  • Technical infrastructure for experimentation — develop the mechanisms to support the site's experimentation program

  • Marketing Ops partnership — implementation of forms, gated content, and attribution instrumentation (GTM, GA4, HubSpot)

  • Cybersecurity posture — maintain security and run routine safety audits across dependencies and scripts

  • High-velocity shipping — ship complex site improvements and launch campaign pages in a product-driven atmosphere

  • AI-native workflow — use agents in your daily build process and create tooling for safe marketing publishing

We are looking for candidates with:

  • Marketing web development background — ownership of marketing sites, not just product surfaces

  • Enterprise repository ownership: branching strategy, CI/CD, and a strong code-review culture

  • Headless CMS architecture — Next.js with Sanity strongly preferred

  • Modern React ecosystem for the web

  • Vercel as a production platform

  • AI-native development — ability to demonstrate concrete use of AI agents and tooling in your workflow

  • High level of ownership & accountability — a hand raiser who’s ready to join an ambitious team and company

  • Technical leadership — directing or reviewing the work of agency developers

Our ideal candidates also have:

  • Prior experience with internationalization (i18n/l10n): URL architecture, locale routing, and multi-region infrastructure

  • Familiarity with A/B testing on production marketing sites

  • Interest in voice AI and the future of voice-interactive web experiences

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

raw.description:
About Piomic

Piomic Medical AG is an award-winning Zürich medtech company on a mission to change how chronic and acute wounds are treated. Our lead indication is diabetic foot ulcers, a condition with one of the highest mortality rates in healthcare. Our breakthrough COMS® therapy (Concurrent Optical and Magnetic Stimulation) is a non-invasive treatment that delivers physical stimulation to deep tissue for wound healing. Our team of biologists, engineers and designers combines high-quality medical research with a close focus on the people who use our devices. Our vision: life shouldn't be defined by a medical condition.

What you'll do

  • Develop and evaluate concepts for the packaging, fixation and accessories of a medical device
  • Design geometry variants in CAD and produce them including additive manufacturing
  • Build functional prototypes and demonstrators and test them for handling and fit
  • Help develop a test setup that recognizes single-use components, from requirements to a working demonstration
  • Document designs, tests and decisions so they can feed into regulated product development

What you bring

  • Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's program in industrial design, product design, mechanical/medical engineering or a related field
  • Hands-on skills in CAD and prototyping, including 3D printing
  • An independent, structured way of working and careful documentation
  • English, German is a plus

Nice to have

  • Experience with plastics, silicone or injection-molded parts
  • Basic electronics or embedded programming, for example microcontrollers or RFID/NFC
  • Interest in regulated products such as medical devices
  • You like to tinker and build things that work

What we offer

  • ownership from day one: your designs become working prototypes that go into testing
  • Hands-on impact on a breakthrough therapy for one of the deadliest conditions in healthcare
  • First-hand experience of how medical devices are developed under European and US regulatory requirements
  • A paid position with competitive pay
  • Hybrid work and a modern open workspace directly at the Zurich HB
  • Flexible hours that fit around your lectures and exams

Contact: Jari Kruth, CTO

raw.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:

  • Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

  • Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

  • Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

  • Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving:

  • Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

  • Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration:

  • Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

  • Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

  • Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

  • Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

  • Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices:

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

  • Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

  • Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

  • Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

  • Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

  • Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

  • Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

  • Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

  • Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

  • State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

  • Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

  • Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

  • Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

  • Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

  • Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

description: Warum Ovivamed? Wir bei Ovivamed haben uns eine klare Mission gesetzt: Wir machen eine nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich. Hierzu bauen wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten auf. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen langfristig erfolgreich zu managen, indem wir uns auf das konzentrieren, was am meisten zählt: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität nachhaltig zu steigern. Bisher haben wir bereits über eine Million Menschen in der Schweiz, in Deutschland und in Grossbritannien erfolgreich begleitet. Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams und gestalte die Zukunft der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mit! Die Rolle Als Leitende Medizinische Praxisassistentin (a) steuerst du das tägliche operative Geschäft unserer Ovivamed-Praxisstandorte in der Schweiz (Zürich, Bern, Basel, Luzern). In dieser vielseitigen und verantwortungsvollen Rolle führst du ein engagiertes Team von Medizinischen Praxisassistent*innen und Medizinstudierenden. Du stellst einen reibungslosen Patient*innenfluss sowie die kontinuierliche Einhaltung unserer hohen klinischen und operativen Standards sicher. Als mitarbeitende Führungspersönlichkeit arbeitest du aktiv im Praxisalltag mit, unterstützt das Team von der Front aus und befähigt deine Kolleg*innen gleichzeitig zu fachlicher und persönlicher Bestleistung. Deine Aufgaben: Teamführung & Entwicklung : Du leitest, mentorst und schulst bestehende sowie neue Teammitglieder vor Ort und förderst deren berufliche Weiterentwicklung. Praxisorganisation : Du überwachst und optimierst die täglichen Abläufe in den Praxisstandorten, um eine nahtlose Patient*innenerfahrung und effiziente, gut strukturierte Abläufe zu gewährleisten. title: Data Engineer
description: De IT-afdeling van Den Hartogh (25 collega's) werkt als één team aan de groei en doelstellingen van ons familiebedrijf, verdeeld over clusters als IT Operations, Architecture & Security en Data Integration & Analytics. Als Data Engineer binnen dat laatste cluster help je de business proactief bij het behalen van haar zakelijke en financiële doelen, met data in de breedste zin van het woord. Via applicaties, dashboarding en ad-hocanalyses moderniseer je ons datalandschap, en er is volop ruimte om te innoveren met predictive & generative AI, Data Science en Process Automation (RPA) . Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Data Integration & Analytics. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen organisatie en processen enerzijds en techniek anderzijds; Als sparringpartner voor de business til je de managementinformatie naar een hoger niveau, in innovatieve en complexe dataprojecten; Je onderhoudt en breidt onze data pipelines in SQL uit en bouwt een semantisch model ; Je voert ad-hocanalyses uit met SQL (en R) en stimuleert continue verbetering via data- en procesanalyse; Je werkt nauw samen met data professionals om de bruikbaarheid van interne en externe data te verbeteren. Jij bent onze ideale kandidaat als je: Een bachelor of master hebt in Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, Data Science, Analytics of vergelijkbaar; Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring hebt in een vergelijkbare functie én minimaal 4 jaar met SQL ; Sterk bent in SQL, DAX, dimensioneel modelleren, data vault modeling, versiebeheer en Scrum ; Uitstekend communiceert in Nederlands en Engels (woord en geschrift) en een scherpe, kritische blik hebt, daarnaast durf je tegen de business aan te schuren; Proactief en resultaatgericht bent, met een sterke drive om te blijven verbeteren en jezelf te ontwikkelen; Pré : 2+ jaar ervaring met Machine Learning-modellen, geavanceerde Power BI-kennis en ervaring met het implementeren van AI-modellen in een organisatie. Wat bieden wij? Een salaris tussen € 4.000,- en € 5.400,- bruto per maand (naar kennis en ervaring), plus laptop en telefoon van de zaak, 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. fulltime), 8% vakantiegeld , een feestdagengratificatie van € 550,- bruto, reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling; Ruimte om te ondernemen : een uitdagende functie met veel zelfstandigheid, flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid, binnen een groeiende en informele organisatie met ambitieuze doelen; Hybride werken vanuit ons Basecamp in Rotterdam (bij fulltime 3 dagen kantoor, 2 thuis): een moderne werkomgeving met uitzicht over de Waterweg, een inhouse gym, restaurant en de Den Hartogh Academy met meer dan 500 trainingen; Een internationale, maar familiaire werkomgeving, met betrokken collega's van over de hele wereld; Oog voor elkaar : een fijne werksfeer, een caring- en vitaliteitsbudget en toegang tot Benefits at Work met aantrekkelijke kortingen. title: Senior Account Manager
description: Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden. Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee. Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap. Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen. In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde. Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten. Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product. Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software. Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen. Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug: Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen. Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting. Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert. Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager. Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling. Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag. MEER WETEN? Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? App of bel Mak via +31 6 18 60 98 89. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Ops
description: About Cantina: Cantina Labs is a social AI company, developing a suite of advanced real-time models that push the boundaries of expression, personality, and realism. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning. If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future! About the Role: We are looking for an ML Engineer to own the production inference stack for our text-to-speech (TTS) and speech recognition (ASR) models, end to end. Our research team delivers trained model checkpoints; you will productionize them as low-latency, real-time streaming services that run cost-efficiently on GPUs. The role covers the inference engines, the Kubernetes infrastructure they run on, and the performance benchmarking and accuracy validation that let us ship changes safely. You will bridge research and production, and own latency, throughput, cost and accuracy as we scale. What You’ll Do: Build and optimize streaming inference engines for TTS and ASR models, including multi-stage model pipelines. Optimize latency (time to first chunk, p50/p99) and throughput using continuous batching, CUDA Graphs, torch.compile and mixed precision. Maintain numerical parity with the reference implementation through automated accuracy regression tests, per stage and end to end. Deploy and operate GPU inference services on Kubernetes: autoscaling, containerization and infrastructure as code. Build CI/CD for model artifacts, with model versioning and reproducible releases. Own observability and performance benchmarking: p50/p99 latency, real-time factor (RTF), GPU utilization and cost per request. Partner with research to productionize new models. What You’ll Bring: Hands-on experience deploying, scaling and optimizing ML models in production, beyond consuming model APIs. Working knowledge of the full inference stack, from CUDA kernels to serving frameworks, with depth in some layers; expertise across all of them is not expected. GPU performance optimization: profiling (Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler), memory bandwidth, CPU-GPU synchronization. Solid understanding of model serving: continuous batching, KV cache management, request scheduling. Production experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure. Strong Python and PyTorch, and a rigorous approach to performance benchmarking. Experience with speech or audio models (TTS, ASR, voice conversion). Experience with inference frameworks such as vLLM (vLLM-Omni), SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT or Triton Inference Server. Compensation: When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered, including skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data. Benefits for U.S.-based roles: Competitive salary and generous company equity Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 99.99% of premiums covered by Cantina 42 days of paid time off, including: 15 PTO days 10 sick days 15 company holidays 2 floating holidays Generous parental leave & fertility support 401(k) retirement savings plan Lifestyle spending account – $500/month to use however you’d like Complimentary lunch and snacks for in-office employees One Medical membership, and more!

raw.jobDescription:
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

As a Senior CXE Engineer, you are a hands-on builder on enterprise contact center transformations. You will spend the majority of your time in code and in the AWS console: building contact flows and AI agents, writing Lambda functions and CDK stacks, developing React-based agent and admin tooling, and debugging production issues on systems that serve tens of thousands of agents and millions of customer interactions. You work within architectures set by practice leads, and you’re expected to pressure-test them, propose better patterns, and own the implementation quality of your workstream from first commit through production cutover. This role blends deep Amazon Connect platform engineering, generative AI development on Bedrock and Claude, and full-stack serverless work, with regular direct interaction with customer engineering teams.

Your Assignment

AI Agent & Conversational AI Development

  • Build AI-native self-service using Amazon Connect AI agents, Amazon Q in Connect, and Amazon Bedrock (Claude model family), implementing multi-agent orchestration patterns, orchestrator agents delegating to task-specific agents with escalation paths to human queues
  • Engineer prompts and tool-calling integrations at production scale: SearchProfiles lookups, case creation, external API tools, authentication flows, and guardrails against hallucination and verification loops
  • Implement barge-in handling, fallback, and error-recovery behavior for voice AI, and validate it with turn-by-turn trace analysis
  • Optimize inference cost and latency hands-on: model tier selection (Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus), prompt caching, and token budgeting against containment- rate targets
  • Diagnose AI agent performance using observability tooling (agent spans, and CloudWatch) that correlates contact flow logs, conversation transcripts, AI agent spans, tool executions, and token usage to isolate latency, cost, and quality issues
  • Build conversational experiences where intent-based NLU is the right fit, including multilingual support and SSML-tuned voice interactions

Amazon Connect Platform Engineering

  • Build contact flows that integrate AI agents, Lambda-backed business logic, Customer Profiles, and dynamic data-driven routing
  • Implement Amazon Connect Cases and Tasks solutions: case templates, queue-based work allocation, SLA/TAT monitoring, approval workflows, and migrations from legacy case systems (e.g., consolidating hundreds of service categories and thousands of business rules into a unified Cases model)
  • Configure and operationalize Contact Lens for real-time sentiment, post-contact summaries, category rules, and quality management
  • Implement proficiency-based and attribute-driven routing, outbound campaigns (including answering machine detection and compliance controls), and workforce management (WFM) integrations for forecasting, scheduling, and adherence (FCS)
  • Build out the Amazon Connect analytics data lake (Glue, Lake Formation, Athena) and QuickSight dashboards for real-time operations and executive reporting
  • Support legacy platform migrations (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, Salesforce): flow conversion, data migration, parallel-run validation, and production cutover on live contact centers

Full-Stack & Portal Engineering

  • Build custom Agent Workspace experiences with the Amazon Connect Streams API, third-party app embedding, and CRM screen-pop integrations (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, custom systems)
  • Build serverless, event-driven backends with Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, and Kinesis for real-time event processing and customer journey orchestration
  • Treat accessibility as a first-class requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant components, automated axe-core/Playwright accessibility scanning, and support for VPAT/Section 508 documentation on government and enterprise engagements

Infrastructure, Delivery & Quality

  • Author infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) as the primary tool and CloudFormation or Terraform where customer environments require them
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and automated test suites: Jest/Vitest unit tests, Playwright E2E and API tests, and integration tests against live Connect instances
  • Follow phased rollout patterns for production contact centers where downtime is measured in missed calls; write the runbooks that make cutovers boring
  • Instrument monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and custom dashboards across voice, chat, tasks, queues, agents, Lambda, and AI agents) and participate in production incident triage
  • Apply security and compliance baselines in everything you ship: least-privilege IAM, DevSecOps scanning, encryption standards

Collaboration & Practice Contribution

  • Work directly with customer engineering teams: pair on integrations, run technical working sessions, demo completed workstreams, and lead knowledge transfer so customers can operate what you build
  • Contribute to architecture decisions within your workstream; evaluate native Connect capability before custom builds (“configuration over customization”), surface trade-offs to practice leads, and document decisions
  • Perform code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and mentor junior and mid-level CX engineers through pairing and review feedback
  • Contribute reusable assets back to the practice, shared CDK constructs, skills/plugins, demo environments, and internal tooling, so the next engagement starts further ahead
  • Support pre-sales when needed: build proof-of-concept demos and provide implementation-grounded input on estimates and SOW technical scope

Your Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including 2+ years building on Amazon Connect or comparable CCaaS platforms at enterprise scale
  • Strong, current Amazon Connect skills: contact flows, routing, Cases and Tasks, Contact Lens, Customer Profiles, Streams API, and the Connect data/analytics stack
  • Hands-on experience with conversational and generative AI, Amazon Lex plus LLM- based development (Amazon Bedrock, Q in Connect, or equivalent), including prompt engineering and tool calling
  • Strong TypeScript/Node.js and Python; production React experience; solid AWS serverless engineering (Lambda, EventBridge, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, Kinesis)
  • Infrastructure as code proficiency with AWS CDK or Terraform, including multi- account deployment patterns
  • Experience shipping and supporting production systems, testing discipline, observability instrumentation, and incident debugging across the full stack
  • Clear communication with customer-facing composure, able to demo your work, explain trade-offs, and run working sessions with client engineers

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML/Connect-relevant Specialty)
  • Contact center migration experience (Avaya, Genesys, Cisco, Oracle, or Salesforce to Amazon Connect)
  • Experience in regulated verticals: government/public sector (Section 508, FedRAMP), healthcare (HIPAA), or financial services
  • Contact center operations fluency: WFM concepts (forecasting, scheduling, adherence), quality management, outbound compliance (TCPA), and CX KPIs (containment, AHT, CSAT, SLA/TAT)
  • Experience with AI observability (trace correlation, token/cost attribution, latency profiling) or accessibility engineering (WCAG 2.1 AA, axe-core automation)
  • Consulting or client-delivery background

Benefits

  • 100% remote work
  • Medical Insurance for you and eligible dependents
  • Generous holidays and flexible PTO
  • Competitive phantom equity
  • Paid for exams and certifications
  • Peer bonus awards
  • State of the art laptop and tools
  • Equipment & Office Stipend
  • Individual professional development plan
  • Annual stipend for Learning and Development
  • Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture

NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time.

raw.jobDescription:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Core AI Squad, you'll design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform capabilities that power intelligent product experiences across Cloudbeds. This is a product engineering role focused on production AI systems, agentic workflows, evaluation, and observability - not an internal tooling role. You'll work primarily in Python while collaborating across our broader PHP and Java ecosystem, building systems where correctness, reliability, latency, cost, and model quality are core to the job. Your goal is to help Cloudbeds ship AI-powered customer experiences that are useful, trusted, scalable, and measurable.

Our Core AI Squad:

The Core AI Squad owns the customer-facing AI platform infrastructure, agentic workflows, and evaluation and observability foundations that enable AI-powered experiences across Cloudbeds products. The team builds the production capabilities that let us evaluate models and providers for specific use cases, orchestrate tools and workflows, measure quality over time, and integrate AI safely into real customer journeys. You'll join a senior, product-minded group that values ownership, pragmatic architecture, fast learning, and strong collaboration across product, design, data, and engineering.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Design, build, and operate customer-facing AI platform services and product features primarily in Python, while integrating with PHP and Java systems as needed
  • Build and evolve agentic harnesses, including agent runtimes, workflow orchestration, tool execution, state management, recovery paths, and evaluation hooks
  • Integrate agents and LLM-powered workflows into production systems with strong attention to reliability, correctness, latency, scalability, and cost
  • Evaluate models and providers for specific product use cases, using clear success criteria and abstractions that keep the platform flexible as the AI ecosystem evolves
  • Own evaluation, tracing, observability, and quality feedback loops for AI features so the team can detect regressions, understand behavior, and improve over time
  • Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code and advocate for engineering best practices, test automation, maintainability, and operational excellence
  • Collaborate with product, design, data, security, and engineering partners to turn ambiguous AI product opportunities into reliable customer-facing features
  • Comfort building, debugging, and operating services that interact with PostgreSQL, SQS, gRPC, and REST APIs, including data models, event streams, service contracts, and versioning
  • Contribute as a senior individual contributor through technical leadership, architecture input, pair programming, code reviews, and mentorship

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building, shipping, and operating production systems
  • Strong proficiency with Python in production environments, including APIs, services, tests, debugging, and operational ownership
  • Hands-on experience building, integrating, or evaluating agentic systems, agent harnesses, tool orchestration, or LLM-powered workflows
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LangSmith, LangGraph, or similar platforms (PydanticAI, CrewAI, etc)
  • Experience with MCP, vector databases, retrieval patterns, RAG architectures, or AI evaluation platforms
  • Comfortable working across a polyglot stack, especially contributing to or integrating with PHP and Java services when the product requires it
  • Familiarity with prompt and version management, guardrails, tracing, LLM observability, cost and latency optimization, or human-in-the-loop workflows
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerization such as Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, plus experience working with remote-first, globally distributed teams
  • Experience with API-driven design, distributed systems, data modeling, and reliable service boundaries
  • Strong knowledge of software best practices, design patterns, performance, security-minded development, and testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, especially in complex systems with uncertain or probabilistic behavior
  • Good product sense, customer empathy, strong communication, teamwork, ownership, and time management
  • Business-level English fluency, verbal and written

Compensation: Depending on your skills and experience, you can expect your annual compensation to be between $140,000 and $180,000 USD. Please note that we maintain high flexibility, and packages above this range will be considered. (The salary is only for US-based candidates).

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. raw.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

As a Security Engineer, you’ll own application security for a fast-growing AI companionship platform. This is a hands-on AppSec role: you’ll review code, find real vulnerabilities and drive fixes across the stack. You’ll be the main security person in the company, reporting directly to our CTO and Co-Founder. You’ll set direction yourself and explain risk clearly to non-security colleagues. Our product includes AI-generated content, including NSFW content, and you’ll also keep an eye on AI-specific threats like prompt injection. Real ownership from day one.

This isn’t an infrastructure, networking or DevSecOps role: we’re looking for application security depth.

Key Responsibilities

Application security (the core of the role)

  • Review code every week to catch vulnerabilities before they ship

  • Find, prioritize and drive fixes for real vulnerabilities across the stack, not surface-level issues

Audits and pentests

  • Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests

  • Challenge findings where needed, and follow them through to fixes

Engineering and automation

  • Automate security work and build the tools you need to scale it

  • Use AI tools daily in your security work: code review, pentests and scripting

Ownership and communication

  • Own security end to end with little support, and decide what matters most

  • Explain technical risk in plain words to the team and leadership

  • Cover security alerts, including occasional night and weekend on-call

Also part of the role (lighter)

  • Keep a simple risk register and GRC documentation up to date

  • Share security updates with the team and run awareness training

  • Watch emerging AI threats (prompt injection, jailbreaks, content filter bypass) and incidents at our AI providers

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

  • 2+ years of hands-on security experience

  • Hands-on AppSec, not compliance only: you review code regularly and can walk us through a real vulnerability you found and fixed

  • Audits and pentests: you’ve coordinated an external audit or pentest and followed the findings through to fixes

  • Engineering workflows: you ship code with Git/GitHub, script in Python or Bash, and have recent hands-on work on a modern web stack (e.g. Rails, Node; GCP, Heroku or similar)

  • Ownership with little support: you’ve been the sole or lead security person, or owned a security area on your own. You’ve reviewed code or tested systems every week in the last 2 years, and you explain risk clearly to non-technical people

  • AI in your daily work: you use AI tools every day in your security work

  • A hacker mindset: You love breaking things to make them safer, and security isn’t only your job: you do it for fun too, through bug bounties, CTFs, research, write-ups or your own tools.


Nice-to-haves

  • ⭐ AI/LLM security testing (prompt injection, jailbreaking): a strong plus

  • Experience at an AI company or a scale-up

  • GRC awareness

  • Familiarity with MDM and access management


Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🧢 Goal-orientated, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable working in an environment with products that are based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

title: Stage Bouw
description: Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! Dit wordt jouw stage Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! description: At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀 Job Summary As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling. You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org. Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows. Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform. Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases. Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team. Business Systems Integration & Architecture Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design. Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines. Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies. Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly. Platform Development & Tooling Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead. Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively. Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization. Reliability, Observability & Continuous Improvement Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations. Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches. Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team. Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions. Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution. Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry. Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments. Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred). Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it. Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs. Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems. NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript, SuiteBundler, saved searches, and data model — particularly as it relates to order management, billing, and revenue recognition. Hands-on experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS platforms — including multi-step flows, error handling, and observability. Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, and MCP integrations. Experience with ClickUp Super Agents is a strong plus. Job Summary

As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling.

You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Native Automation & Agent Development

  • Design and build AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across the GTM tech stack — including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, and MuleSoft — to eliminate manual effort and accelerate business operations.

  • Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows.

  • Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform.

  • Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases.

  • Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team.

Business Systems Integration & Architecture

  • Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design.

  • Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines.

  • Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies.

  • Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly.

Platform Development & Tooling

  • Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead.

  • Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively.

  • Utilize Zapier, Workato, and similar iPaaS platforms to orchestrate cross-system workflows that are maintainable, observable, and well-documented.

  • Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

Reliability, Observability & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations.

  • Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches.

  • Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team.

  • Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.

  • Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution.

  • Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for business systems automation and AI — educating stakeholders on what's possible and setting realistic expectations on scope and delivery.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role.

  • Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred).

  • Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it.

  • Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

  • Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems.

Skills & Competencies

Technical

  • Salesforce configuration, automation (Flow, Process Builder), Apex, and data model design — admin or developer-level proficiency required.

  • NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript, SuiteBundler, saved searches, and data model — particularly as it relates to order management, billing, and revenue recognition.

  • Hands-on experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS platforms — including multi-step flows, error handling, and observability.

  • Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, and MCP integrations. Experience with ClickUp Super Agents is a strong plus.

  • Proficient with Python, JavaScript, or Apex for automation scripting and data transformation; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth-based integrations.

  • Strong understanding of business systems data models and integration patterns (event-driven, batch, real-time).

Operational & Mindset

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build — from reliability and documentation to stakeholder trust and continuous improvement. You don't hand off and walk away.

  • Velocity: You move fast, iterate, and ship. You know when "good enough and deployed" beats "perfect and blocked," and you never sacrifice reliability or data integrity to get there.

  • AI & Automation mindset: You default to asking "how can an agent or LLM handle this?" before reaching for a manual workflow — experimenting confidently and evaluating critically.

  • Collaboration: You bridge the gap between technical architecture and business impact, asking clarifying questions, challenging assumptions respectfully, and earning trust with the stakeholders you support.

What You'll Work With

  • NetSuite: ERP platform — SuiteScript, workflows, order management, billing, and revenue recognition flows.

  • ClickUp Super Agents: AI-powered automation and agentic task orchestration within the ClickUp ecosystem.

  • Integration stack: Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier — recipe/flow development, cross-system orchestration, and platform observability.

  • AI & MCP tooling: LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflow design, and production AI integration patterns.

  • Low-code tooling: Retool, Replit, or similar for internal applications and workflow extensions.

  • Scripting & APIs: Python, JavaScript, Apex, REST/webhook integrations, and JSON-based data transformation.

title: Software Engineer, Data Integration
description: Software Engineer, Data Integration In Brief We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives. Who We Are Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved. What you’ll do You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform to generate real-time lifesaving clinical insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' technical teams, you'll turn fragmented data into immediate, actionable clinical insights that empower care teams to make the best decisions for their patients. Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a lab result isn't reaching the Bayesian platform for a patient, you have thirty minutes and the client's full attention to trace it from the inbound HL7 message through parsing, mapping, and ingestion, and tell them what happened. Responsibilities Data Integration & Ingestion: Partner with the client's technical teams to design and implement the data integration interface and ingestion pipelines that feed the Bayesian platform with real-time clinical data, powering insights that improve patient outcomes. Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests at the data layer, and work directly with client technical teams during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations. Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring build and configuration for the data interface, ingestion, and mapping are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any data integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication. Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the data integration workstream with the overall integration effort. Minimum qualifications BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience 3+ years building and deploying data pipelines to production, including integration with external APIs (Python preferred) Strong ability to investigate and resolve data correctness problem end-to-end, across services, storage, and external data sources. Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment Experience writing automated integration tests for production systems Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Project/Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results. Preferred qualifications Experience with health data, integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, and Health IT interoperability standards such as HL7v2 and FHIR. Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require. Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity Bayesian Health provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
